_about: John Spottiswoode (1565-1639), Archbishop of St Andrews: The History of the Church of Scotland, ed. Michael Russell and Mark Napier (Spottiswoode Society and Bannatyne Club, Edinburgh, 1847-1851, 3 vols). An episcopal history of the Reformation in Scotland, the counterweight to Calderwood and Row. Volume numbers read off each title page. The surname check takes the spellings the edition uses. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
